unchanged_recipe.baseline: Exact v1.43 skill-regressed 2027 release; player history 2023–2026, fixed population priors through 2025
unchanged_recipe.feature_definition: Official exported fraction of all BBE; BBE>=30 and existing v1.21 masks. Historical rows must additionally pass v1.22 RESEARCH_ELIGIBLE_RECONCILED_DEFINITION. No archive proxy substitution.
unchanged_recipe.excluded_feature_families: direction/pull-air, EV, bat tracking, baserunning, pitch arsenal and other unresolved or short-history families are audited but not predictors
unchanged_recipe.feature_pooling: Within prior four source years, BBE x 1:2:3:4 exposure weighting; all three metrics from a complete compatible source season; unknown not zero.
unchanged_recipe.training: Residual target count/exposure minus exact historical v1.43-style component rate. Train only on eligible targets strictly earlier than origin. Targets 2024 and 2025 available; 2026 targets prohibited.
unchanged_recipe.model: Single fixed ridge per role, penalty 20, intercept unpenalized; earlier training-weighted standardization, z clipped [-4,4], sample weights=min(target denominator,600) normalized to mean 1; minimum100 training players/seasons. No hyperparameter or feature search.
unchanged_recipe.application: Half predicted residual x frozen forecast denominator, capped to plus/minus half baseline count. Hitters adjust 1B/2B/3B while holding HR fixed and respecting AB; pitchers adjust SO/BB and recompute WHIP.
unchanged_recipe.anchors: PA/AB/IP/OUTS, HR, pitcher H/ER/ERA/W/SV/HLD/G/GS/QS and hitter R/RBI/SB/BB/HBP/SF/SH unchanged; no workload, minor, park or international changes
unchanged_recipe.guard_comparator: V1_43 versus STATCAST_RESEARCH using original phase.gate math; internal aliases weighted_actuals/skill_regression map to those arms only for executing unchanged guard code
unchanged_recipe.historical_scoring: 2024 warmup unsupported without earlier compatible Statcast targets. 2025 is the first possible out-of-sample forecast. Unsupported warmup does not count as a supported fold.
unchanged_recipe.2026_source_quality: Structural sample/range/BBE checks only; no saved full 2026 event reconciliation. 2026-dependent Statcast production adjustments forbidden until source definition/event scope is reviewed.
unchanged_recipe.release_policy: Publish replayed baseline, exploratory candidate, adoption-gated candidate and long differences. Failed role gates or missing inputs retain entire baseline vector. Exploratory values never silently replace production.
unchanged_recipe.2026_data_usage: 2027 player history/input audit only; frozen decision and model hashes written before opening holdout labels
limitations: At most one independent earlier-supported scoring origin with supplied official definitions
No new MLB opportunity for minor/international-only players
Metric eligibility differs and missing features are explicit
No inference that a CSV family existing means its scope is validated

allowed_change: Add earlier compatible source observations and apply independently specified scope masks, increasing earlier training/scoring years. No changes to target components, pooling, ridge penalty, damping, caps, baseline or adoption thresholds.
older_definition: Use actual bb_type categorical counts on regular-season type=X physical in-play records, divided by ALL in-play BBE. Require every in-play record classified as ground_ball/line_drive/fly_ball/popup and total BBE>=30. No angle threshold or direction proxy.
compatibility_bridge: Before admitting 2021/2022 require deterministic all-BBE category fractions and BBE denominator to match every formerly admitted 2023-2025 research bundle against archived pitches. Any mismatch is held and prevents declaring an unconditional bridge.
2026_scope: Check every 2026 batted-ball export row against the season archive, including exact all-BBE denominator, categorical numerators, regular-season/game identity and missing classification. Admit only matching row bundles with existing masks and BBE>=30. Never fix counts by substitution.
archive_integrity: Read frozen windows for2021-2025; use COMPLETE ledger windows for2026. Verify all raw/parquet/schedule hashes and row counts. Unique physical pitch keys, no multiple type=X per PA. Check archive game IDs against cached, previously certified full-season MLB schedules and standings.
schedule_scope: Final regular-season games only; cancelled/postponed entries not performance outcomes. Scope proof is retrospective as of preserved source snapshots.
2026_performance_usage: Audit/2027 source history only. No 2026 target, residual, forecast error, tuning or fold is allowed.
publication: Working v1.43 baseline immutable. Candidate must pass unchanged role guards before player-level adoption review. No automatic production installation.
documentation_basis: MLB documents type X as in play and bb_type as the four named classes; no release-position or ABS measurement enters these fractions.
